docs.summary: Posts a message to a Slack channel. The message text can be fixed or built from the item that triggered it.
docs.mode: Runs once per item — an item in means a message out.
docs.when: Use it to notify people about what the workflow found or did.

params.name: channel
params.text: The destination channel, including the leading #.

params.name: text
params.text: The message. Plain text, or an expression to build it from the item.

examples.label: A message built from the item

gotchas: One message per item. Wire it after a Filter that passed forty items and it sends forty messages — aggregate first if you want a single summary.
The channel must match exactly, including the #.
